scenarios.name: invalid_matches_throw
scenarios.description: validateMatch must throw for each case (messages are part of the contract).

expected.label: draw
expected.error: Invalid match bad: exactly one team must have the target score

expected.label: nobody at target
expected.error: Invalid match bad: exactly one team must have the target score

expected.label: loser over target
expected.error: Invalid match bad: the losing score must be between 0 and target - 1

expected.label: negative score
expected.error: Invalid match bad: the losing score must be between 0 and target - 1

expected.label: non-integer score
expected.error: Invalid match bad: scores must be integers

expected.label: target 7
expected.error: Invalid match bad: target must be 5 or 10

expected.label: to-5 scored to 10
expected.error: Invalid match bad: exactly one team must have the target score

expected.label: same player twice
expected.error: Invalid match bad: a player cannot appear twice

expected.label: player on both teams
expected.error: Invalid match bad: a player cannot appear twice

expected.label: three players on a team
expected.error: Invalid match bad: each team has 1 or 2 players

expected.label: empty team
expected.error: Invalid match bad: each team has 1 or 2 players

expected.label: unknown player
expected.error: Invalid match bad: unknown player zz

expected.label: NaN playedAt
expected.error: Invalid match bad: playedAt must be a finite timestamp

expected.label: 1v2 (team sizes differ)
expected.error: Invalid match bad: both teams must have the same number of players

expected.label: NaN createdAt
expected.error: Invalid match bad: createdAt must be a finite timestamp

expected.label: empty id
expected.error: Invalid match : id must be a non-empty string

scenarios.name: leaderboard_sections
scenarios.description: Tie-break rating desc, matches desc, name asc, id asc; sections inactive (>= 30 days, or never played and created >= 30 days ago) > rookies (< 10 matches) > ranked.

scenarios.name: undo_seq_and_restore
scenarios.description: nextSeq ignores deletion; restore keeps the slot; lastEntered = greatest createdAt; deletedAt must be a number to count; duplicate seq throws.

scenarios.name: name_tiebreak_accents
scenarios.description: Five players tied on rating and matches: order by accent-stripped lower-cased name, then raw name (Émile before émile), then id.
